# Story 15.1: Red-phase tests for packaged-Electron non-dev NODE_ENV launch

Status: ready-for-dev

## Story

As a developer,
I want red-phase tests asserting the packaged Electron app launches its server child with an explicit non-dev `NODE_ENV` so auth/CSRF are enforced in shipped builds,
So that Story 15.2 has a defined, executable contract to make pass when it fixes the silent `development` default (P0 item #2 from Aspect 9 of the critical review).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A spec asserts that the packaged launch path in `apps/electron/src/main.ts` sets an explicit non-dev `NODE_ENV` on the forked server child (e.g., `production` or a dedicated `'desktop'`) rather than defaulting to `'development'`.
2. A spec asserts that under that non-dev `NODE_ENV`, `auth.ts`'s `isDevEnvironment()` returns false and `shouldSkipAuth` does NOT skip JWT validation for all routes — i.e., auth/CSRF enforcement is active in the shipped build.
3. All assertions in AC #1–#2 are marked `.skip()` (`it.skip`) so the suite runs green BEFORE Story 15.2 exists — red-phase by skip, not by failure. Existing passing tests remain unskipped and green.
4. The spec file(s) run green under `nx test server` (and/or the electron app's test target) immediately after this story (new red-phase tests skipped), and Story 15.2's first task is to remove the `.skip()` markers, confirm they FAIL against current code, then implement until they pass.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1 (AC: #1): Add a non-dev NODE_ENV assertion for the packaged launch path.
  - [ ] 1.1 In a spec covering `apps/electron/src/main.ts`'s server-fork logic, assert that when no `NODE_ENV` is present in the child env, it is set to an explicit non-dev value (not `'development'`).
- [ ] Task 2 (AC: #2): Add an auth-enforcement assertion under non-dev.
  - [ ] 2.1 In a spec covering `apps/server/src/app/plugins/auth.ts`, assert that with a non-dev `NODE_ENV`, `isDevEnvironment()` is false and `shouldSkipAuth` does not skip JWT validation for all routes.
- [ ] Task 3 (AC: #3, #4): Mark red-phase assertions `.skip()` and confirm green.
  - [ ] 3.1 Apply `it.skip` to every assertion added in Tasks 1–2 — they are red until Story 15.2 fixes the launch path. Leave all pre-existing tests unskipped.
  - [ ] 3.2 Run the relevant test target(s) and confirm fully green with only the new red-phase tests skipped. Do NOT weaken or delete any assertion to achieve this — skip markers only.

## Dev Notes

- **Why:** `apps/electron/src/main.ts:107-108` defaults the forked server child's `NODE_ENV` to `'development'`, and `auth.ts`'s `isDevEnvironment()` (dev/test/local) makes `shouldSkipAuth` skip JWT validation for ALL routes in that mode — so the shipped desktop app runs with zero API authentication. This is P0 item #2 from Aspect 9.
- **Red-phase TDD:** this story is ordered before Story 15.2. Assertions are marked `it.skip` so CI stays green while the `development` default still exists; Story 15.2's first task removes the skip markers, confirms red, then fixes until green.
- **Do NOT modify production code in this story** — test scaffold only. The launch-path fix belongs to Story 15.2.
- Vitest is the workspace test framework; server tests run via `nx test server`.

### Project Structure Notes

- Create/modify: a spec covering `apps/electron/src/main.ts`'s fork logic (assert non-dev NODE_ENV default).
- Create/modify: a spec under `apps/server/src/app/plugins/auth.spec.ts` (or sibling) asserting auth enforcement under non-dev.
- No changes to production `.ts` in this story.
